hypothesis: For identical validated model parameters, packing signed coefficients and the complete encoded section payload will reduce full-artifact bytes by at least 20% on at least 75% of development tasks, without material codec or downstream validity regression, compared with the canonical DPK3 artifact.

comparison.baseline: canonical DPK3 encode_kernel output, including 56-byte header, checksums, section tags, varints, and compression
comparison.existing_candidate: candidate DPK4 encode_kernel output, including 64-byte header, packet headers, checksums, model layout, q4/q8 unit packets, and f32 packet
proposed_candidates: signed coefficient q4 with per-tensor scale
signed coefficient q8 with per-tensor scale
bit-packed section framing with canonical decoder

source_and_model_holdouts.sources: No external or sealed sources in this deterministic codec pilot; no source data is read.
source_and_model_holdouts.models: Synthetic validated regression and binary kernels at 4, 12, and 24 feature widths are development fixtures only. They are not source/model holdouts and cannot establish generalization.
source_and_model_holdouts.holdout_admission: Require separately authorized, sealed development holdouts before any production admission claim.

candidate_set: future signed-coefficient q4/q8 and section-framing variants

measurement.unit: complete artifact bytes from identical in-memory numerical parameters
measurement.success_rule: At least 20% byte savings on at least 75% of dev tasks, with canonical decode, validity, downstream behavior, and legacy compatibility intact.
measurement.stricter_s2_target: 25% savings, reported separately and not used as the initial pass threshold.

budget.retry_policy: No unchanged retry. A failed run requires a recorded repair before one bounded rerun.

stop_rule: Stop after the single pilot if full-artifact savings fail the 20%/75% threshold, if either decoder is non-canonical or invalid, if any legacy fixture changes, or if the 60-second/36-encode cap is reached. Only an admitted pilot may proceed to the one development run; no automatic campaign.

results.wall_clock_cap_status: exceeded by cold compilation (60-second preregistered cap); fixture execution itself was 0.13 seconds; preserved as a protocol deviation and no retry is authorized
results.decision: Stop after pilot under the preregistered rule. Current DPK4 candidate fails the byte target on every case and has substantial JSON-layout/framing overhead. The cold build also exceeded the 60-second wall-clock cap, recorded as a protocol deviation. The proposed signed-coefficient and section-bitpacking variants were not implemented or measured; no development study is admitted.
results.limitations: Synthetic fixtures are development examples, not source/model holdouts. These results do not establish behavior on sealed or production workloads.

admission: Blocked by the failed pilot gate: no winning coefficient/section packing mechanism exists, and the measured DPK4 candidate is larger on every fixture. Preserve DPK3 as the canonical writer; do not claim a byte saving or run an unchanged retry.
